const sale = $json;
return [{ json: {
  OperationId: sale.operationId,
  EmpresaId: sale.empresaId,
  UsuarioId: sale.cashier,
  Cajero: sale.cashier,
  CajaSesionId: sale.cajaSesionId,
  ClienteNombre: sale.customerName,
  Fecha: sale.createdAt,
  MetodoPago: sale.paymentMethod,
  Subtotal: sale.subtotal,
  DescuentoPorcentaje: sale.discountPercent,
  Total: sale.total,
  EfectivoRecibido: sale.cashReceived,
  Vuelto: sale.change,
  Estado: 'PENDIENTE'
} }];

const sale = $items('VerificarVentaCreada')[0]?.json || {};
return (sale.detailRows || []).map((row) => ({ json: { ...row, Venta: [sale.ventaId] } }));

const sale = $items('VerificarDetalle')[0]?.json || {};
return (sale.stockRows || []).map((row, index) => ({ json: { ...row, Venta: [sale.ventaId], DetalleVenta: sale.detalleIds && sale.detalleIds[index] ? [sale.detalleIds[index]] : undefined } }));

const sale = $items('VerificarMovimientosStock')[0]?.json || {};
return (sale.stockUpdates || []).map((update) => ({ json: { id: update.id, 'Stock Actual': update.stockAfter, stockBefore: update.stockBefore, stockAfter: update.stockAfter } }));

const sale = $items('VerificarMovimientoCaja')[0]?.json || {};
return [{ json: { id: sale.ventaId, Estado: 'CONFIRMADA' } }];

const rollback = $items('PrepararRollback')[0]?.json || {};
return [{ json: { ok: false, error: rollback.error || 'SALE_PROCESSING_ERROR', message: rollback.message || 'No se pudo completar la venta', operationId: rollback.operationId || null, ventaId: rollback.ventaId || null, failedStep: rollback.failedStep || 'UNKNOWN' } }];
